subject: POC ops charter & environment choice for MedQuery trial
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@medquery.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC ops charter & environment choice for MedQuery trial

Thanks again for taking time today, Aisha — good conversation. Per our discovery, I captured a concise ops-level POC charter and a proposed path for the trial environment. Please review and confirm assumptions below so we can lock timelines.

Summary / assumptions
- Goal: Validate MedQuery search augmentation workflow for clinician note summarization and CODA retrieval within 30-day trial.
- Primary success criteria (customer-defined):
  * end-to-end latency for a typical query under 2.5s (95th percentile)
  * semantic relevance > 0.65 on our sample prompt set (see attached MQ_trial_eval_template.xlsx)
  * no PHI egress — all data to remain in customer VPC if we run private trial
- Users: 3 pilot clinicians + 1 SRE (load/ops testing)

Options for trial environment (pros/cons)
1) Hosted (Redwood API, no network changes) — fastest to start (48–72h), lower cost, good baseline for inference. Cons: cannot guarantee customer-managed VPC; acceptable only if MedQuery is okay with data adjacency and transient tokens.
2) Dedicated Sandbox (reserved GPU pool in our environment) — predictable throughput, isolated capacity, supports SOC2 audit logs. ~5 business days to provision. Good middle ground.
3) Private VPC (customer-managed VPC peering or on-prem package) — required if MedQuery needs guaranteed data isolation/PHI controls. Provisioning depends on their security team (we estimate 2–4 weeks).

Proposed next steps (please confirm by EOD Tue):
- Aisha: confirm environment preference (hosted / dedicated / VPC) and whether PHI will be in-scope for the trial.
- MedQuery IT: if VPC, share network firewall / peering contacts and the minimal network requirement doc (attached).
- Rishi (cc): will scope quantization & model suggestion once environment is finalized.
- Marissa (cc): will own dedicated sandbox provisioning and SLA expectations.

Attachments: MQ_trial_eval_template.xlsx (eval prompts and metrics), redwood_trial_network_requirements.pdf

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@medquery.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedQuery IT <techops@medquery.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC ops charter & environment choice for MedQuery trial

Thanks Laura — this is great and close to what we discussed. Quick answers/clarifications from the MedQuery side: 

- PHI: yes, PHI will be in-scope for the pilot. We need to ensure no raw PHI leaves our VPC; pseudonymized extracts are acceptable for hosted-only evaluation, but final decision leans toward Private VPC.
- Environment preference: leaning Private VPC given compliance team guidance, but we'd like to understand what we can achieve faster via Dedicated Sandbox while approvals complete. Can we run initial functional tests on Dedicated and then migrate to VPC for PHI validation?
- Timeline: target pilot start = 2027-04-18; 30-day window.
- Contacts: looping in our IT inbox for network intake.

Aisha Malik
Head of Product, MedQuery Health
aisha.malik@medquery.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@medquery.com>, MedQuery IT <techops@medquery.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC ops charter & environment choice for MedQuery trial

Laura / Marissa — thanks. Operational notes from infra/model perspective: 

- If MedQuery wants to do a two-stage approach (Dedicated -> VPC), we can support that. Suggestion: start with a small hosted/dedicated smoke test (non-PHI data) to validate integrations and latency within 72–96 hours. Then schedule VPC cutover for the PHI run. This reduces waiting time for approvals.
- Model recommendation: start with rw-instruct-13b-quant (balanced latency/quality). For strict latency targets, we can provide a 8-bit quantized variant and tuned batching. Rishi will prepare a config recommendation doc (quant/model/batching) once we confirm environment.
- Ops owners: Rishi (model/config lead), Marissa (provisioning), Laura (customer PM). Please confirm who will be the MedQuery engineering owner for cutover.

Rishi
Principal Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@medquery.com>
Cc: MedQuery IT <techops@medquery.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC ops charter & environment choice for MedQuery trial

Quick operational checklist and realistic lead times: 

- Dedicated Sandbox: provisioning + internal validation = 4 business days from signed SOW. We can reserve a small GPU pool (2x A10s equivalent) for the pilot.
- Private VPC: network intake + peering + security review = 10–20 business days depending on MedQuery timelines. We will need: CIDR to peer, egress rules, IP allowlist for our control-plane endpoints, and an SFTP endpoint if they want logs shipped nightly. See attached network doc.
- Data-in-place options: if MedQuery insists PHI never leaves their network, we can run our Private on-prem package; that requires site access and takes longer.

Proposed milestone plan (if we agree two-stage):
1) Week 0 (by Apr 6): sign SOW / NDA amendment for PHI scope; confirm pilot users and data subset.
2) Week 1 (Apr 7–13): Dedicated sandbox provisioning + smoke tests with synthetic/pseudonymized data.
3) Week 2–3 (Apr 14–27): VPC provisioning and security sign-off in parallel; plan cutover by Apr 18 if feasible.
4) Pilot run (Apr 18–May 18): 30-day evaluation window.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@medquery.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedQuery IT <techops@medquery.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC ops charter & environment choice for MedQuery trial

This works for us — we agree to the two-stage path. Next actions from MedQuery:
- Tech ops will start the network intake today (you should see our intake ticket in the drive link).
- I will review and populate the MQ_trial_eval_template.xlsx with our clinical prompt set by Apr 6.
- I'll have our security lead confirm the minimal peering info; aim to have peering ready for test cutover by Apr 18.

Thanks all — please proceed with provisional sandbox reservation and Rishi please share the config recommendation by tomorrow COB.

Aisha
